title: Single-dev dynamic regression discovery, trusted native promotion and one-use owner UAT exception
user_story: The owner develops with AI on dev, verifies locally, then promotes through qa to main using honest phase-specific evidence.

requirements.description: Only dev source writes; no new development branch.
Latest exact-source PR/run/check-suite and every mandatory job must succeed before native merge.
Automatically discover tests, fail zero-case Python modules, execute2Dthen3D.
Require external owner code-pinned persistent policy; no arbitrary PR/log authority.
Publish only genuine existing hash-bound evidence, rejecting unsafe paths and stale success.
One owner-granted Spark local run maximum600seconds/six steps, preserve original3failures, deny replay.

nonfunctional: Preserve user work, history, all skills/ and agent/ files
Only owner-authorized qualified native forward auto-merge; never bypass protected QA
At most three persistent repair invocations; only the separately owner-granted single600second/six-step Spark UAT exception may exceed the old exhausted UAT ledger
Bound archive download/inventory; no arbitrary CLI/log instruction execution
Desired coverage100% informational; >95% was an estimate.
Native GitHub merge only after every mandatory software/live/research/UAT gate.
outputs: Measured informational coverage and explicit deferred test records
preconditions: Trusted dev worktree and reviewed owner policy
postconditions: No mandatory software skip/FAIL becomes PASS
QA/main missing live evidence remains blocked
acceptance_criteria: Required software regression executes/PASS100% without coverage percentage threshold
SDK installation fails closed on changed/unsafe archive

scenarios.expected: Actual private Git rejects nondev creation without changing HEAD.
Only exact qualifying run is considered; a skipped mandatory job blocks.
Dev push cannot emit the skipped protected QA context.
New offline spec is included automatically without live-model opt-in.
Missing owner permission or changed pinned controller blocks.
Validate bounded ZIP/hash before writing; reject traversal and duplicate paths.
Newest failed/pending dispatch cannot reuse older success.
One use only; original3failure bytes unchanged; new filename cannot replay.

recovery: Preserve raw failures and state. Repair only confirmed root cause on dev, maximum3 invocations; no ledger resets or fake evidence.
test_environment: Explicit offline policy fixtures, isolated actual Git repositories and bounded archive fixtures. MOCKED aggregate does not certify remote GitHub/AI execution.

review.method: Same-agent adversarial review; not independent scientific/browser acceptance.
